in_sanskrit.name: Khuman
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God of Water
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Khuman एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Khama' meaning 'water' and 'Manas' meaning 'mind' or 'God'. In Hindu mythology, Khuman represents the god of water and is often associated with purity, cleansing, and renewal.
